scope: source-preserving structural JSON operations, inspector actions, schema additions and edit ownership
checks: source-preserving add/remove/replace, insertion, exact array duplication/moves and escaped property rename
BOM/CRLF, unknown values, escaped string spelling, unsafe prototype names, long integers and decimal tokens remain intact
invalid pointers/positions, duplicate keys, root removal and nesting refusals before publication
attached-schema suggestions/defaults are explicit; ordinary validation still reports required/collection constraints
actual dialog actions publish one undoable edit; invalid input/root changes and stale resource/schema/read-only ownership refuse
reparsed but unchanged saved resources retain working render-stamped controls
actual inspector exposes collection/primitive actions; saved controls work after reparse and stale field handlers cannot overwrite another edit
actual asynchronous schema import rejects obsolete reads, serializes saves to the captured category, rejects duplicate/non-schema roots and validates boolean false schemas
limits: Small authored JSON and controlled Node DOM/dialog hosts only. No native build, terrain generation, registry/state enumeration, GPU work, broad suite or GitHub workflow. Real browser layout/focus/modal/storage and full schema/release qualification remain pending. Suggestions cover up to 300 direct resolved schema properties; unknown fields remain editable without invented defaults.

relatedTargetedChecks.scope: Exact decimal/schema constraints and one small deleted-resource restore/overwrite-conflict case.
